A '''nameless moon''' was located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Battle of Terror" /> At some point by approximately [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Battle of Terror" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> a terrible [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Battle above a nameless moon|battle]] was fought above the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] between forces of two cults&mdash;the [[Knell of Muspilli]], a [[Death/Legends|death]] cult<ref name="Battle of Terror" /> from<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> the Unknown Regions<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> location known as the [[Gunninga Gap/Legends|Gunninga Gap]],<ref name="TUR" /> and the [[Warriors of Shadow]],<ref name="Battle of Terror" /> a [[Priest/Legends|priestly]] [[Gender/Legends|sisterhood]] of the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]]<ref name="TUR" /> [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> that had fled to the Unknown Regions from<ref name="TUR" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the latter's prehistory.<ref name="TEA" /> In the aftermath of the battle, wreckage, including derelict [[Starship/Legends|starships]], remained at the moon.<ref name="Battle of Terror" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around 3643 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to the nameless moon to study the wreckage of the battle. Aboard one of the remaining ships, the companion discovered an artifact belonging to one of the two cults.<ref name="Battle of Terror" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The nameless moon was mentioned in an Archaeology Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="Battle of Terror" />
